note: 15 приложений Mora. Веб-интерфейс и read-only агентный прототип реализуются отдельно от привилегированных драйверных операций; карточка приложения не означает наличия универсального драйвера.

platforms.windows: Hardware snapshot, PnP/driver metadata, Driver Store export and opt-in Windows Update driver search/install.
platforms.linux: Read-only sysfs/procfs inventory, DMI/UEFI, PCI/USB, modules, memory, storage and exposed sensors.
platforms.macos: Host identification only; detailed native inventory adapter is not yet implemented.

privilege_model: Snapshot collection is read-only and should run without elevation where the OS permits.
Driver Store export requires administrator rights and only copies installed packages.
Windows Update driver installation requires an exact update ID, interactive confirmation, a successful driver backup and a System Restore checkpoint.
No driver binary patching, kernel memory writes, arbitrary register writes or unattended firmware flashing.

Any privileged or system-changing action requires a separate native confirmation.
